name: dot-transition
title: Dot Transition
description: Canvas 2D dot grid that grows into a silhouette mask, holds, then shrinks away before cycling to the next image. Click advances the cycle early; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between grid cells, in px.

props.name: growDuration
props.description: Seconds for a shape to grow in from the resting grid.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Seconds a fully formed shape holds before shrinking away.

props.name: shrinkDuration
props.description: Seconds for a shape to shrink back down to the resting grid.

props.name: gapDuration
props.description: Seconds of plain resting grid between shrink and the next grow.

props.name: revealAnchor
props.description: Where shapes grow from / collapse into, as a fraction of height (0 = top, 1 = bottom).

props.name: dotColor
props.description: Hex color used for the dots.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color behind the dot grid.
